spec: Remediate the OWASP MASVS-STORAGE hardcoded secret vulnerability in `VaultStore.kt`: remove the hardcoded signing secret, require an injected/environment secret provider (throwing `IllegalStateException` if blank), use HMAC-SHA256 with constant-time `MessageDigest.isEqual`, and make `verifyToken` pass all assertions in `Main.kt` (do NOT import `kotlin.test.*`).

Create `timerq.c` implementing a thread-safe bounded ring buffer of capacity 8 using `pthread_mutex_t` and `pthread_cond_t`, plus a `main()` spawning 4 producer and 4 consumer threads (50 items per producer) verifying exact sum with `assert`, printing 'ALL TESTS PASSED'.

Fix `TreasuryBoundedPool.kt` so `acquire()` and `release()` are thread-safe and properly block when empty/full using `ReentrantLock` and `Condition` (`try { ... } finally { lock.unlock() }`), avoiding lost wakeups (`signalAll()`). Do NOT import `kotlin.test.*`. Verify `Main.kt` prints 'ALL TESTS PASSED'.
Fix the JNI-style UTF-8 C++17 buffer truncation/off-by-one and `std::mutex` race in `audit_ring.hpp`/`audit_ring.cpp` and ensure `CMakeLists.txt` builds and passes `ctest` across 4 threads.
